caption: The video captures two helmeted paddlers in pink shirts riding a small craft built from two blue cylindrical pontoons across an artificial whitewater course lined with stacked blue barriers. Spectators watch from an elevated platform in the background. At the start they sit upright amid the churning green water and white foam, gripping a long yellow-bladed paddle raised above their heads. As the sequence progresses the craft begins to heel, its occupants tilting with it while still clutching the paddle. The lean steepens into a full roll, lifting the pale underside and the blue pontoons clear of the surface and throwing the paddlers into the water. Afterward the overturned hull lies on its side, drifting with one boot protruding upward from beneath it. The other paddler stays afloat to the right, the paddle shaft jutting vertically from the foam. The camera pans left, tracking the capsized craft as it settles flatter and slides downstream past a Walgreens banner.
relations: Churning water motion against the pontoons causes the raft to heel and roll, throwing the paddlers into the water.
As the hull capsizes, the overturned craft drifts downstream, leaving one boot protruding and the other paddler afloat.
The paddle shaft remains jutting vertically from the foam as the camera pans left to track the capsized raft.
